items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 uses 95% fewer em dashes, but its answers are getting longer
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 appears to be changing how it writes, with new analysis showing fewer obvious AI writing patterns, shorter sentences, and simpler wording compared with Opus 5. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft pauses KB5002907 update after Office license deactivations
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Microsoft has paused the rollout of the KB5002907 Microsoft 365 update after users report that it deactivated, or in some cases completely removed, perpetual Office 2016 and Office 2019 installations. [...]</article>

items.title: GitHub Actions re-enabled with Mini Shai-Hulud payload still active
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Two third-party GitHub Actions previously compromised in a Mini Shai-Hulud campaign were re-enabled by their maintainer and remained accessible for more than a week despite still pointing to malicious code. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI's AI agents accidentally uploaded user-provided images to third-party sites
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>OpenAI says its AI agents uploaded user-provided images to third-party image-hosting services while carrying out research and evaluation tasks. [...]</article>

items.title: Kiteworks urges 6-hour server shutdown over potential zero-day attacks
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Secure file-sharing software company Kiteworks is urging customers worldwide to temporarily shut down their servers on Saturday for a six-hour window after receiving threat intelligence warning of a potentially imminent cyberattack. [...]</article>

items.title: ShinyHunters hacked Clop leak site using Grav CMS path traversal flaw
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>The Clop ransomware gang has moved its data leak site to a new Tor address after confirming its previous server was compromised and defaced through an unpatched Grav CMS flaw that BleepingComputer has learned is an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability. [...]</article>

items.title: Elementor WordPress flaw lets attackers create admin accounts
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the Elementor plugin for WordPress could allow an unauthenticated attacker to create administrator accounts. [...]</article>

items.title: CISA warns of Sharepoint, WSO2, Adobe Commerce flaws exploited in attacks
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warns that hackers are exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430) affecting multiple products from enterprise software provider WSO2. [...]</article>

items.title: Anthropic rolls out up to $250 in free Claude Code credits, but only for cloud sessions
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>Anthropic now allows you to run Claude Code via cloud sessions without signing up for the research preview, and it's offering up to $250 in free usage credits, so more users can give it a try. [...]</article>

items.title: OpenAI is preparing a $500 ChatGPT Pro Max plan with faster Codex
items.author: Mayank Parmar
items.content: <article>OpenAI appears to be preparing a new ChatGPT Pro Max subscription that could cost $500 per month, but it's unclear when it'll begin rolling out. [...]</article>

items.title: With the Rise of AI Agents, SOC 2 Should Adapt or Risk Irrelevance
items.author: Sponsored by Token Security
items.content: <article>AI agents can operate through human credentials and take actions that existing SOC 2 controls may not distinguish from human activity. Token Security explains why SOC 2 needs to adapt to address the security gaps created by agent identities. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft plans to deprecate Windows Deployment Services
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft announced it will deprecate the Windows Deployment Services (WDS) server role starting with the next Windows Server release. [...]</article>

items.title: Rydox marketplace admin pleads guilty, faces 22 years in prison
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>A Kosovar national has pleaded guilty to operating Rydox, a large illegal online marketplace that sold stolen personal information, login credentials, credit card details, and cybercrime tools. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft: Recent Windows updates cause desktop loading issues
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft has confirmed that some users may experience desktop loading issues, including black screens, after installing the August 2026 preview updates and subsequent updates. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers steal $351.6 million in Bitget crypto exchange hack
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>​Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget disclosed today that suspected North Korean hackers have stolen $351.6 million from its hot and warm wallets. [...]</article>
